description: ΗΛΕΚΤΡΟΠΑΡΑΓΩΓA ΖΕΥΓH is a dataset listed in data.gov.gr, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by ΔΙΕΥΘΥΝΣΗ ΒΙΟΜΗΧΑΝΙΑΣ, ΕΝΕΡΓΕΙΑΣ ΚΑΙ ΦΥΣΙΚΩΝ ΠΟΡΩΝ. ELECTRICITY GENERATOR. Coverage: ΔΙΕΥΘΥΝΣΗ ΒΙΟΜΗΧΑΝΙΑΣ, ΕΝΕΡΓΕΙΑΣ ΚΑΙ ΦΥΣΙΚΩΝ ΠΟΡΩΝ. The portal shows the English title as "ELECTRICITY GENERATOR" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is ΔΙΕΥΘΥΝΣΗ ΒΙΟΜΗΧΑΝΙΑΣ, ΕΝΕΡΓΕΙΑΣ ΚΑΙ ΦΥΣΙΚΩΝ ΠΟΡΩΝ. Its keywords include Ενέργεια, Ηλεκτροπαραγωγο ζευγοσ. The listing shows 2 download or service links in CSV. The listing shows 2026-05-18 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support energy network and generation-capacity studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-data-gov-gr.
